description: Education Consumer Price Index (CPI) sub-group by country, monthly index values (2015=100) and annual averages. Covers COICOP Division 10 (Education) for 17 European countries plus Switzerland. For Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Canada: education-specific CPI sub-groups are not published via open APIs; see individual country statistical agency websites.

primarySources.source: ONS Consumer Price Inflation detailed reference tables
FRED (St. Louis Fed) via OECD MEI

note: Japan (JPN), New Zealand (NZL), Australia (AUS), and Canada (CAN) education CPI sub-groups are not available via FRED or OECD SDMX APIs. See Eurostat HICP file for EU-wide education inflation context.

GBR.note: Ends Nov 2020; ONS D7C5 preferred for UK (see ons-uk-education-cpi.json)
